card.name: Right before the word die
card.fires_on: The word just before a form of die, died, dies or killed, usually a subject such as they, people, them or all. It is common in text about deaths, wills and disasters.

modes.label: Subject before die
modes.description: A pronoun or noun for people sits right before a form of die.
modes.example: A Will is a legal document which sets out a person's wishes on what happens to their property when<< they>> die.

modes.label: Counts of deaths
modes.description: A number of people or victims comes just before a word for dying or being killed.

modes.label: Linking word before die
modes.description: A comma, adverb or small word sits between the subject and die.
modes.example: approximately 1.8 million people, 90 percent of whom are children under 5<<,>> still die every year from diarrheal

card.writes: It lowers the chance of the word dead and its variants, and favors other words.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before 'die' or 'died' when the text is about people dying.
